title: Saying hello
summary: A first lesson on greeting classmates and introducing yourself.
canDo: Greet someone and give your name.
Ask how someone is and answer.
lessonOutline: Practice I'm and My name is.
Ask and answer How are you?
Exit check: introduce yourself in two sentences.
conversationPrompts: You meet a new classmate. Introduce yourself.
Ask your partner how they are today.
Say goodbye at the end of class.
Introduce a friend to the group.
